agent.problem: The blank asks for the exact BSB word "proclaimed," which has not appeared in any earlier card. Although the alternatives make one choice more plausible, the card is still testing wording the baker has not seen rather than a meaning established by the setup.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: The second half of verse 3 is handled only by negating the statement that Israel alone has seen God's salvation. No card supplies the positive detail that all the ends of the earth have seen it, leaving an important part of the verse's worldwide scope unstated.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.
